sloka: न तम् वध्यम् अहम् मन्ये सर्वैः देव असुरैः अपि ।अयम् अस्य वध उपाय तत् एकमनाः शृउणु ॥३-३१-२८॥
transliteration: na tam vadhyam aham manye sarvaiḥ deva asuraiḥ api ।ayam asya vadha upāya tat ekamanāḥ śṛuṇu ॥3-31-28॥

translations.english: I do not think it is possible for gods and demons together to kill him, yet there is a way for his destruction. You may listen to me with single mindedattention:
